logs.detail: Grow bays 19-24 online. Full agricultural capacity achieved across all 24 bays.
Q4 2092 yield report: 37,800 kg total. Exceeding targets by 8%. Leafy greens performing above projections.
Nutrient solution mixing tank 2 serviced. Replaced agitator motor and recalibrated pH sensors.
New wheat variety (Luna-7) introduced in bays 11-12. Expected first harvest in 90 days.

Secondary irrigation circuit now shared with Prometheus Lab for synthesis water draw per project 2093-P4. Capacity allocated: 15% of primary Aquifer feed. No impact on crop irrigation at current demand levels.
Annual grow light inspection complete. 6 units replaced in bays 3 and 7. All bays within PAR specifications.
Q1 2094 yield report: 38,200 kg. Stable. Luna-7 wheat performing well in test bays.
Climate control system updated to v4.2. Improved humidity response curves for tropical crop bays.
